name: Created decks persist across a full page reload
description: After generating a deck, reloading the page keeps the deck available in the Decks / recent decks list and it can be reopened.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root URL /, stay on the 'Studio — structured' tab, type the brief 'Competitive analysis of electric scooter sharing companies' into the 'A · Brief' textarea and click 'Forge the outline'.
Wait for the 'Outline proposal' view, note the deck title shown, then click 'Approve & write N slides' and wait until the editor opens (allow up to 120 seconds).
Navigate back to the landing page state (use the browser back button or any 'Back' control until the landing workbench is visible).
Reload the page (navigate to the root URL again).
Scroll to the 'Decks' section (recent decks list) on the landing page.
Verify the recent decks list contains at least one deck card, including the deck title noted earlier (or a deck titled from the same brief).
Click that deck card to open it.
Verify the editor opens showing the saved slides for that deck (slide canvas visible with content).
